greeting.description: The seasonal greeting message, or "Hello World" when no holiday falls within the 10-day window.

holiday.description: The name of the holiday that triggered this greeting. Null when the greeting is the fallback "Hello World".

daysUntil.description: Number of days between today and the holiday's peak date. Negative means the holiday already passed (within 10 days ago). Zero means today is the holiday. Null when the greeting is the fallback "Hello World".
